title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Calculate excise taxes
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces automated excise tax calculation for products and services across different regions. The feature provides a flexible framework supporting various tax bases like weight, volume, and alcohol content, helping businesses comply with tax regulations and reduce calculation errors.
key_points: The excise tax framework automates duty calculation by product and region; the first release has no statutory reports
Excise tax types define a tax basis such as weight, volume, quantity, sugar content, alcohol volume or active content
Excise entry types decide which item ledger entry types (purchase, sale, adjustments, output) count toward the taxable quantity, and duty rates set the final amount
Items get an excise tax type, an excise unit of measure and a quantity for excise tax on the Excise Tax tab of the Item Card
The Excise Journal generates entries from item ledger quantities for a date range; registered entries appear in Excise Taxes Transaction Logs

quotes.text: The excise taxes feature helps businesses by automating the complex process of calculating excise tax amounts.
quotes.why_it_matters: It shows the core business value of reducing manual work and errors in tax calculation

quotes.text: The framework supports different calculation models and can be adapted to meet various regulatory requirements through configuration.
quotes.why_it_matters: It explains the flexibility of the initial release to support multiple regional tax scenarios

quotes.text: Excise Tax Journal entries will be automatically generated based on Item Ledger Entry quantities for the specified date range.
quotes.why_it_matters: It describes the key automation mechanism that processes tax entries without manual calculation
